{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate by site
response_rates = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)

# Display the response rates
response_rates"}
